faqs.question: Are all text tools on ilovetexts.com really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, every single one of our {count}+ tools is completely free — no hidden fees, no usage limits, no premium tiers, and no registration required.

faqs.question: Is my text data safe and private on ilovetexts.com?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All text processing happens 100% in your web browser using client-side JavaScript. We never send, store, save, or log your text on any server.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account to use the tools?
faqs.answer: No! No account, no registration, no sign-up of any kind is required.

faqs.question: Do the tools work on mobile phones and tablets?
faqs.answer: Yes! All {count}+ tools are fully responsive and work perfectly on all mobile browsers.

faqs.question: Can I use the tools offline?
faqs.answer: Yes! Once a tool page is loaded, the core functionality works offline. You can install ilovetexts as a Progressive Web App (PWA).

schema.howToDesc: Step-by-step guide to use the free online {toolName} tool on {domain}.
